title.zh: 将泰亚巴斯省从第六司法区划入第七司法区、将民都洛省从第七司法区划入第六司法区，规定泰亚巴斯省法院期庭在泰亚巴斯镇与博阿克镇举行，并修正第100号法案的法案
title.en: AN ACT TRANSFERRING; THE PROVINCE OF TAYABAS FROM THE SIXTH TO THE SEVENTH JUDICIAL DISTRICT, AND THE PROVINCE OF MINDORO FROM THE SEVENTH TO THE SIXTH JUDICIAL DISTRICT, PROVIDING FOR THE HOLDING OF THE TERMS OF COURT FOR TAYABAS AT THE TOWNS OF TAYABAS AND BOAC, AND AMENDING ACT NUMBERED ONE HUNDRED
title.orig: AN ACT TRANSFERRING; THE PROVINCE OF TAYABAS FROM THE SIXTH TO THE SEVENTH JUDICIAL DISTRICT, AND THE PROVINCE OF MINDORO FROM THE SEVENTH TO THE SIXTH JUDICIAL DISTRICT, PROVIDING FOR THE HOLDING OF THE TERMS OF COURT FOR TAYABAS AT THE TOWNS OF TAYABAS AND BOAC, AND AMENDING ACT NUMBERED ONE HUNDRED
title.vi: Đạo luật chuyển Tỉnh Tayabas từ Khu tư pháp 6 sang Khu tư pháp 7 và Tỉnh Mindoro từ Khu tư pháp 7 sang Khu tư pháp 6, quy định phiên tòa tại các thị trấn Tayabas và Boac, và sửa đổi Đạo luật số 100
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติโอนจังหวัดตัยยาบาสจากเขตตุลาการที่6ไปยังเขตตุลาการที่7และจังหวัดมินโดโรจากเขตตุลาการที่7ไปยังเขตตุลาการที่6กำหนดให้มีการนั่งพิจารณาคดีที่เมืองตัยยาบาสและโบแอคและแก้ไขพระราชบัญญัติฉบับที่100
title.id: Undang-Undang Memindahkan Provinsi Tayabas dari Distrik Yudisial 6 ke Distrik Yudisial 7 dan Provinsi Mindoro dari Distrik Yudisial 7 ke Distrik Yudisial 6, Menetapkan Sidang Pengadilan di Kota Tayabas dan Boac, serta Mengubah Undang-Undang Nomor 100
title.ms: Akta Memindahkan Wilayah Tayabas daripada Daerah Kehakiman 6 kepada Daerah Kehakiman 7 dan Wilayah Mindoro daripada Daerah Kehakiman 7 kepada Daerah Kehakiman 6, Menetapkan Persidangan Mahkamah di Bandar Tayabas dan Boac, serta Mengubah Akta Nombor 100

text.en:
(a) Paragraph eight of section one of Act Numbered One hundred and forty is hereby amended to
read as follows:
" The Sixth Judicial District shall consist of the Provinces of La Laguna, Cavite, and Mindoro. "
Paragraph nine of said section one of said Act is hereby amended to read as follows:
" The Seventh Judicial District shall consist of the Provinces of Batangas and Tayabas. "

(a) Subdivision seven of section three of Act Numbered One hundred and forty, relating to the
Sixth Judicial District, is hereby amended by striking out the third, fourth, and fifth paragraphs thereof and
substituting therefor the following:
" At Calapan, in and for the Province of Mindoro, commencing on the first Tuesdays of April and October of
each year, until suitable accommodation for the court can be constructed at Puerto Galera in the same
Subdivision eight of section three of said Act Numbered One hundred and forty, relating to the Seventh
Judicial District, shall be amended by striking out the second and third paragraphs thereof and substituting
therefor the following:
" At Tayabas, in and for the Province of Tayabas, commencing on the first Tuesdays of April and October of
" At Boar, in and for the Island of Marinduque, commencing on the third Tuesdays of February and August
of each year. "

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, November 10, 1902.
